Name: Licensed users with privileged roles
Description: Lists licensed users that hold Entra ID directory roles (privileged only, or all), including PIM eligible assignments and roles granted through role-assignable groups. Read-only. Eligible assignments need Entra ID P2.
Author: Admin Toolkit

Parameters.Name: RoleFilter
Parameters.Label: Roles to include
Parameters.HelpText: Privileged = roles Microsoft marks as privileged; All = every directory role

Parameters.Name: IncludeEligible
Parameters.Label: Include PIM eligible
Parameters.HelpText: Also include PIM eligible (not yet activated) assignments

Parameters.Name: ExpandGroups
Parameters.Label: Expand role groups
Parameters.HelpText: Include users that get the role through a role-assignable group
